journey.name: EXC-04: 后台切换与生命周期恢复场景
journey.description: 验证用户在输入框键入长篇草稿文本中途，将应用切换到后台（模拟用户接打电话或切换应用），随后重新返回前台时，草稿文本与当前会话状态完好无损地被恢复。

actions.action: Click the message input field "输入消息或 / 命令..."
Type "Draft preserving test: checking lifecycle survival under process pause." into the input field
Verify that the input field contains "Draft preserving test: checking lifecycle survival under process pause."
Simulate Home key or background task switch
Simulate returning to the open-android-intelligence app from background
Verify that the message input field still retains the draft text
Verify that the workbench is in the active connected state
